build_semseg_metric_evaluator: build a semantic segmentation evaluator using SemSegMetric to compute mIoU, mDice, and mFscore metrics
create_semseg_metric_instance: create a SemSegMetric instance with mIoU metrics and an output directory for saving prediction masks
test_process_batch: test the SemSegMetric process method to compute prediction statistics for a batch of segmentation samples
refactor_compute_pred_stats: refactor the _compute_pred_stats method to support additional ignore index handling for segmentation evaluation
summarize_print_semantic_table: summarize the print_semantic_table function that prints per class IoU and accuracy results in a PrettyTable
